artwork.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE flat artwork reference for two labels of a fictional premium500mL liquid handsoap, Summit Sight GOOD HANDS. Wide landscape canvas, two equal-sized tall ivory rectangular labels side by side, FRONT on LEFT, BACK on RIGHT. Do NOT print orientation words FRONT or BACK. Clean flat artwork, no bottle, no perspective, no folds, no props, no dimensions, no extra margins. Warm ivory background, deep oxblood-burgundy ink and a thin muted-copper rule; elegant bold editorial serif with clear small sans-serif body copy. This is tactile premium apothecary packaging that feels commercially polished. FRONT LEFT label: small uppercase 'SUMMIT SIGHT' at top, large headline on two lines 'GOOD' / 'HANDS.', restrained copper horizontal line; smaller 'LIQUID HAND SOAP'; lower half a simple thin botanical line drawing of cedar sprig and citrus slice; below exact 'BERGAMOT + CEDAR'; bottom '500 mL'. Keep ample clean space and strong hierarchy. BACK RIGHT label: compact bold 'GOOD HANDS.' then 'DAILY RITUAL'. Short tagline 'Clean hands. Clear head.' Then bodycopy 'A bright bergamot opening, a quiet cedar finish. Made for the moments between everything else.' Section 'HOW TO USE' with 'Pump onto wet hands. Work into a lather, then rinse thoroughly.' Section 'INGREDIENTS' with 'Aqua (Water), Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Sodium Chloride, Parfum (Fragrance), Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Limonene, Linalool.' Section 'CARE' with 'For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children.' Thin rule, small 'SUMMIT SIGHT / STUDIO CONCEPT', black fictional barcode near bottom, '500 mL'. Dense but readable back label, real sentences, accurate upright text, no filler gibberish. Keep every word within its own label. No clinical, medical, antibacterial, certification or environmental claims. No other brand or watermark. Print-ready style mock artwork for a fictional product; two labels constitute one artwork reference.
